verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud is a SaaS platform, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. A probe confirms an official Salesforce MCP server in the salesforcecli GitHub org, which lets an agent connect to the product directly. The AgentExchange item about plugging MCP servers into Agentforce Builder is client-side and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of the server's tools/scope and setup or auth flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://github.com/salesforcecli/mcp
